agent_explanation: With no walls or controller, total mechanical energy should be conserved (minus gravity exchange). The shrunk scenario uses the maximum unstable dt=0.03119 (>1/60) with very high speed ~38 m/s; semi-implicit Euler with substeps still integrates inaccurately, gaining ~137J per step (step0 6860.79 -> step1 6998.44 -> step2 7159.51 -> step4 7551.94) exceeding E0+10%+5J limit. Reducing dt to 0.005 makes integration accurate and energy conserved.
